name: self-expanding-blueprints
title: Self-Expanding Blueprints (SEB)
author: bits-orio
description: Grow a self-expanding factory from your own blueprints. Draw arrows where the next piece attaches, and construction robots keep building copies until water, cliffs or your rules stop them. Each team on a multiplayer server grows its own. A Recursive Blueprints alternative with circuit control; Multi-Team Support (MTS) optional.
